scenario: LLOG.2.7.5: a superseded logical fact's justifications leave with it; none is transferred to the replacement or kept for later, so the key can end up empty. `make` derives Made(id 1) from every Seed with `n` copied from it; `report` logs each live Made's `n`; `vacant` logs when a Seed is live and no Made is. Pump 1: Seed n=4 -> Made(1, 4), `report` logs `made n=4` (`make` outranks `vacant` by source order, so `vacant` is blocked before it can fire). Pump 2: Seed n=5 -> `make` emits Made(1, 5), which supersedes Made(1, 4) [LFAC.1.7.2]; `report` logs `made n=5`. Pump 3: retracting Seed n=5 ends the only activation that justified Made(1, 5), so Made(1, 5) is withdrawn and the key holds no fact although Seed n=4's activation of `make` still matches; `vacant` fires for Seed n=4 and logs `no made`. The three readings give three sequences: transferring Made(1, 4)'s justification to Made(1, 5) keeps it live and logs nothing at pump 3; re-arming Seed n=4's activation re-derives Made(1, 4) and logs `made n=4`; only the reading the clause states logs `no made`. PATH PINNED: truth maintenance on the superseded fact, not the supersede's record order (that is RFCS.6a.4's). libds: the supersede in `ds_rete_wm_assert_ex` (rete/wm_rete.c) retracts Made(1, 4) through `ds_engine_retract_rete_fact`, and the dependency table of rete/tms.c is keyed by activation and lists fact ids, so `make`(Seed n=4)'s row names the withdrawn Made(1, 4) and no row names Made(1, 5) but `make`(Seed n=5)'s. Mercury: `ds.engine`'s settle of the retracted Made(1, 4) calls `ds.tms.forget_fact`, which drops its count and justification set. The lockstep scenario 91_emit_supersede (fixture 124_emit_supersede) holds the two runtimes to each other on the same program; this vector holds them to the clause.
rules_ds:
schema Seed scope logical:
    n: Int key

schema Made scope logical:
    id: Int key
    n: Int mutable

rule make:
    Seed s
->
    emit Made logical id: 1 n: s.n

rule report:
    Made m
->
    log info "made n={m.n}"

rule vacant:
    Seed
    no Made
->
    log info "no made"
